Pricing.source_text:
domain quantity-price "Quantity price function"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner quantity-price-owner
logic sfol-v1

entity PriceTier:
  meaning "PriceTier prototype for the bounded base-price quote."
  priceId: identifier required
  currency: string required
  amountMinor: integer required
  minQuantity: integer required
  maxQuantity: integer required

entity QuoteRequest:
  meaning "QuoteRequest prototype for the bounded base-price quote."
  requestId: identifier required
  requestedCurrency: string required
  requestedQuantity: integer required

calculation LineSubtotal:
  meaning "Exact UInt64 multiplication of selected unit cents by requested quantity; overflow is an error, not rounding."
  inputs amountMinor, requestedQuantity
  expression multiply(amountMinor, requestedQuantity)
  rounding reject

schema RawAmount:
  value: string max 32
  precision: integer const 20

schema Price:
  id: identifier max 128
  price_set_id: identifier max 128
  currency_code: string pattern "^[a-z]{3}$"
  raw_amount: RawAmount
  min_quantity: integer optional nullable min 1 max 2147483647
  max_quantity: integer optional nullable min 1 max 2147483647
  price_list_id: string nullable const null
  rules_count: integer const 0
  deleted_at: timestamp optional nullable

schema PriceSnapshot:
  variant_id: identifier max 128
  price_set_id: identifier max 128
  prices: Price[] max 1000

schema Request:
  request_id: identifier max 128
  variant_id: identifier max 128
  currency_code: string pattern "^[A-Za-z]{3}$"
  quantity: integer min 1 max 2147483647

schema Envelope:
  request: Request
  snapshot: PriceSnapshot optional

schema Quote:
  request_id: identifier
  variant_id: identifier
  price_set_id: identifier
  currency_code: string const "usd"
  status: string pattern "^(quoted|no_price|ambiguous_price)$"
  price_id: identifier optional
  price_ids: identifier[] optional max 1000
  unit_amount: string optional
  unit_amount_minor: string optional
  quantity: integer optional
  subtotal: string optional
  subtotal_minor: string optional

integration Prices:
  transport provided-or-http
  provided input.snapshot
  output PriceSnapshot
  url-env PRICE_SNAPSHOT_URL
  secret-env PRICE_SNAPSHOT_TOKEN
  query variant_id input.request.variant_id
  timeout-ms 3000
  max-bytes 262144

# Each mapping declares a target shape. No assignments, lambdas or flow steps.
mapping PriceRow:
  meaning "Normalize one Medusa price into exact UInt64 cents and inclusive quantity bounds."
  input row: Price
  target PriceTier
  field priceId = row.id
  field currency = row.currency_code
  field amountMinor = decimal(row.raw_amount.value, 2)
  field minQuantity = uint64(coalesce(row.min_quantity, 0))
  field maxQuantity = coalesce(optional_uint64(row.max_quantity), uint64("18446744073709551615"))

query Tiers:
  meaning "Active prices in the supported currency, normalized through PriceRow."
  from row in snapshot.prices
  where not present(row.deleted_at) and row.currency_code == "usd"
  select PriceRow(row)

query Eligible:
  meaning "All normalized tiers whose currency and inclusive bounds match the request."
  from p in Tiers
  where p.currency == lower(input.request.currency_code) and p.minQuantity <= uint64(input.request.quantity) and p.maxQuantity >= uint64(input.request.quantity)
  select p

query Cheapest:
  meaning "Eligible tiers with no strictly cheaper eligible witness; preserve every tie."
  from p in Eligible
  where not (exists q in Eligible: q.amountMinor < p.amountMinor)
  select p

rule NoPrice:
  meaning "No cheapest witness exists."
  condition not (exists p in Cheapest: true)

rule UniquePrice:
  meaning "Exactly one cheapest price witness exists."
  condition exactly_one p in Cheapest: true

rule AmbiguousPrice:
  meaning "At least one cheapest witness exists and it is not unique."
  condition (exists p in Cheapest: true) and not UniquePrice

mapping EmptyQuote:
  meaning "Construct a no-price response preserving request and price-set identity."
  target Quote
  field request_id = input.request.request_id
  field variant_id = input.request.variant_id
  field price_set_id = snapshot.price_set_id
  field currency_code = "usd"
  field status = "no_price"

mapping AmbiguousQuote:
  meaning "Construct an ambiguous-price response with sorted tied identities and their common amount."
  target Quote
  field request_id = input.request.request_id
  field variant_id = input.request.variant_id
  field price_set_id = snapshot.price_set_id
  field currency_code = "usd"
  field status = "ambiguous_price"
  field price_ids = sort(column(Cheapest, "priceId"))
  field unit_amount = format(one(distinct(column(Cheapest, "amountMinor"))), 2)

mapping SelectedQuote:
  meaning "Construct a quoted response and exact subtotal from the unique selected price."
  input p: PriceTier
  target Quote
  field request_id = input.request.request_id
  field variant_id = input.request.variant_id
  field price_set_id = snapshot.price_set_id
  field currency_code = "usd"
  field status = "quoted"
  field price_id = p.priceId
  field unit_amount = format(p.amountMinor, 2)
  field unit_amount_minor = text(p.amountMinor)
  field quantity = input.request.quantity
  field subtotal = format(LineSubtotal(p.amountMinor, uint64(input.request.quantity)), 2)
  field subtotal_minor = text(LineSubtotal(p.amountMinor, uint64(input.request.quantity)))

result QuotePrice:
  bind snapshot from Prices
  require lower(input.request.currency_code) == "usd" else "QUOTE_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY"
  require snapshot.variant_id == input.request.variant_id else "QUOTE_VARIANT_MISMATCH"
  require forall row in snapshot.prices: row.price_set_id == snapshot.price_set_id else "QUOTE_PRICE_SET_MISMATCH"
  require count(distinct(column(snapshot.prices, "id"))) == count(snapshot.prices) else "QUOTE_DUPLICATE_PRICE"
  require forall row in snapshot.prices: coalesce(row.min_quantity, 0) <= coalesce(row.max_quantity, 2147483647) else "QUOTE_TIER_RANGE"
  when NoPrice yield EmptyQuote
  when UniquePrice yield SelectedQuote(one(Cheapest))
  when AmbiguousPrice yield AmbiguousQuote

endpoint QuantityPrice:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/quote"
  input Envelope
  output Quote
  result QuotePrice
  auth-env QUOTE_API_TOKEN
  max-bytes 262144
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status quoted 200
  status no_price 404
  status ambiguous_price 409
  error FUNCTION_ENV_REQUIRED 503
  error FUNCTION_OUTPUT_SCHEMA 500
  error FUNCTION_URL 503
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_TIMEOUT 504
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_LIMIT 502
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_SCHEMA 502
  error FUNCTION_TIMEOUT 408
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_STATUS 502
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_FAILED 502
  error FUNCTION_BODY_LIMIT 413

Shipping.source_text:
domain shipping-quote "Selected shipping option quote"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner checkout-shipping-owner
logic sfol-v1

entity ShippingChoice:
  meaning "An eligible shipping method with exact minor-unit fee."
  optionId: identifier required
  amountMinor: integer required

schema Option:
  id: identifier max 128
  country: string pattern "^[A-Z]{2}$"
  enabled: boolean
  tracked: boolean
  amount: string max 32
  min_weight: integer min 0 max 100000
  max_weight: integer optional nullable min 0 max 100000

schema ShippingSnapshot:
  currency_code: string const "usd"
  country: string pattern "^[A-Z]{2}$"
  generated_at: timestamp
  options: Option[] max 100

schema Request:
  option_id: identifier max 128
  request_id: identifier max 128
  country: string pattern "^[A-Z]{2}$"
  weight_grams: integer min 0 max 100000
  requires_tracking: boolean
  note: string optional nullable max 100

schema Envelope:
  request: Request
  snapshot: ShippingSnapshot optional

schema ShippingResponse:
  request_id: identifier
  status: string pattern "^(available|unavailable)$"
  currency_code: string const "usd"
  option_id: identifier
  fee_minor: string optional
  fee: string optional

integration ShippingOptions:
  transport provided-or-http
  provided input.snapshot
  output ShippingSnapshot
  url-env SHIPPING_OPTIONS_URL
  secret-env SHIPPING_OPTIONS_TOKEN
  query country input.request.country
  query weight input.request.weight_grams
  timeout-ms 3000
  max-bytes 262144

mapping Choice:
  meaning "Convert an eligible provider option to a domain shipping choice."
  input row: Option
  target ShippingChoice
  field optionId = row.id
  field amountMinor = decimal(row.amount, 2)

query Eligible:
  meaning "Enabled methods in the requested country satisfying inclusive weight and tracking requirements."
  from row in snapshot.options
  where row.id == input.request.option_id and row.enabled and row.country == input.request.country and row.min_weight <= input.request.weight_grams and coalesce(row.max_weight, 100000) >= input.request.weight_grams and (not input.request.requires_tracking or row.tracked)
  select row

query Choices:
  meaning "Normalize every eligible option, rejecting malformed eligible fees."
  from row in Eligible
  where true
  select Choice(row)

rule Available:
  meaning "There is at least one eligible shipping choice."
  condition exists row in Choices: true

mapping AvailableResponse:
  meaning "Quote the selected eligible method with an exact fee."
  input choice: ShippingChoice
  target ShippingResponse
  field request_id = input.request.request_id
  field status = "available"
  field currency_code = "usd"
  field option_id = choice.optionId
  field fee_minor = text(choice.amountMinor)
  field fee = format(choice.amountMinor, 2)

mapping UnavailableResponse:
  meaning "Report that the selected option cannot serve this request."
  target ShippingResponse
  field request_id = input.request.request_id
  field status = "unavailable"
  field currency_code = "usd"
  field option_id = input.request.option_id

result SelectShipping:
  bind snapshot from ShippingOptions
  require snapshot.country == input.request.country else "SHIPPING_COUNTRY_MISMATCH"
  require count(distinct(column(snapshot.options, "id"))) == count(snapshot.options) else "SHIPPING_DUPLICATE_OPTION"
  require forall row in snapshot.options: row.min_weight <= coalesce(row.max_weight, 100000) else "SHIPPING_WEIGHT_RANGE"
  when Available yield AvailableResponse(one(Choices))
  when not Available yield UnavailableResponse

endpoint ShippingEligibility:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/shipping-quote"
  input Envelope
  output ShippingResponse
  result SelectShipping
  auth-env SHIPPING_API_TOKEN
  max-bytes 262144
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status available 200
  status unavailable 404
  error FUNCTION_ENV_REQUIRED 503
  error FUNCTION_OUTPUT_SCHEMA 500
  error FUNCTION_URL 503
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_TIMEOUT 504
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_LIMIT 502
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_SCHEMA 502
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_STATUS 502
  error FUNCTION_INTEGRATION_FAILED 502
